user.title: Heating Intelligence
user.description: Set up read-only heating analysis. Configure rooms and global sensors after setup.

menu_options.room_area: Configure room areas, ACH and window contacts

global_settings.title: Global settings
global_settings.description: Select the heating-only cumulative gas meter (not combined hot water), environmental sensors, boiler efficiency assumption and total external envelope area.

data.gas_consumption_entity: Heating-only cumulative gas consumption (m³ or kWh)

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description: Select the room's floor, thermostat demand relay and temperature sensor. Floor area, measured air changes and window contact are optional.

data.enable_co2: Add a CO2 sensor for this room
data.air_changes_per_hour: Measured room air changes per hour (ACH)

room_air_quality.title: Select room
room_air_quality.description: Choose the room whose humidity and CO2 sensors you want to configure.

room_air_quality_config.title: Room air quality
room_air_quality_config.description: Configure humidity and optional CO2 sensors for {room_name}. Disable CO2 to remove its sensor.

room_air_quality_co2.title: Select CO2 sensor
room_air_quality_co2.description: Choose the CO2 sensor for this room.

add_room_co2.title: Add room CO2 sensor
add_room_co2.description: Select the CO2 sensor for {room_name}. CO2 is optional and only requested when enabled for this room.

room_area.title: Select room
room_area.description: Choose a room whose floor area, measured air changes or window contact you want to configure.

set_room_area.title: Room area, ventilation and window contact
set_room_area.description: Set floor area, optional measured ACH and a window contact for {room_name}. Leave unknown values empty.

data.air_changes_per_hour: Measured room air changes per hour (ACH)

pump_settings.title: Pump settings
pump_settings.description: Select instantaneous power (W) and cumulative energy (kWh) sensors for each manifold pump. Leave both fields empty to omit a pump.

edit_room.title: Select room
edit_room.description: Choose the room whose floor assignment you want to change.

edit_room_floor.title: Change room floor
edit_room_floor.description: Set the floor for {room_name}. The currently saved floor is selected by default.

house_assessment.title: Building and envelope
house_assessment.description: Enter known building details. Your known defaults are prefilled; leave unknown values blank. You can revisit and change every answer.

assessment_heating.title: Heating system and thermal mass
assessment_heating.description: Describe the heat source, distribution and thermal storage. Defaults reflect known system details but can be changed.

data.boiler_dhw: Does the boiler also produce domestic hot water?
data.ac_heating: Are air conditioners used for heating?

assessment_occupancy.title: Ventilation and internal gains
assessment_occupancy.description: These inputs help distinguish building heat loss from ventilation, occupancy and internal heat gains. Unknown answers are fine.

abort.no_rooms: There are no rooms to remove.
